deployment.rollback: Create a rollback branch from main, restore the repository content from pre-release commit 2aa70d7db33767f50322d82495818de9ba83c24a, merge the rollback through a reviewed PR, then dispatch pages.yml with governance_approved=true and repeat smoke checks.

tasks.title: Design the Pinch experience
tasks.acceptance: Document focused EN/FR user journeys, responsive wireframes, interaction states, accessibility requirements, and light/dark design tokens for a static prototype.

tasks.title: Build and verify the Pinch prototype
tasks.acceptance: Create a small static HTML prototype under prototype/ with clickable recipe scaling, cook-mode navigation, shopping-list interaction, EN/FR switching, and light/dark themes; verify responsive behavior, keyboard access, and no console errors.

tasks.title: Define the Pinch product and technical specification
tasks.acceptance: Write a concise PRD with numbered requirements and acceptance criteria, a compact architecture with ADRs for i18n and quantity/unit parsing, and a traceable backlog of seven small build slices.

tasks.title: Scaffold the portable bilingual app shell
tasks.acceptance: Create the Vite/TypeScript shell, semantic layout, design tokens, EN/FR catalogs and locale/theme preferences; catalog key drift fails the parity script and every script uses portable path or URL APIs.

tasks.title: Implement quantity scaling and conversion
tasks.acceptance: Implement pure parsing, scaling, same-dimension conversion and locale-aware fraction/decimal formatting from ADR-002, preserving malformed and unknown lines; Vitest covers happy, boundary and error cases.

tasks.title: Add local recipe and data management
tasks.acceptance: Add recipe CRUD, three bilingual samples, versioned localStorage, validated atomic JSON import, export and confirmed clear-all; failures are surfaced and unit tested without mutating valid data.

tasks.title: Build the responsive recipe scaler
tasks.acceptance: Build the approved responsive recipe view with serving controls, metric/imperial display, theme and language switching, keyboard operation, visible focus, reduced motion and WCAG 2.1 AA contrast.

tasks.title: Add the persistent shopping list
tasks.acceptance: Add scaled ingredients to a persistent checklist, merge equal canonical keys, retain unparsed text items, support check/uncheck and clear-checked, and cover merging and persistence with unit tests.

tasks.title: Add accessible cook mode
tasks.acceptance: Implement one-step cook mode with focus containment/restoration, buttons, keyboard and swipe alternatives, state preservation, Wake Lock lifecycle and a localized graceful fallback.

tasks.title: Complete offline PWA and browser coverage
tasks.acceptance: Add repository-relative manifest and service worker, verify core flows and offline startup with Playwright bundled Chromium, assert no runtime third-party calls, and use no hard-coded Windows paths.

tasks.title: Validate PRD acceptance criteria
tasks.acceptance: Verify every numbered PRD acceptance criterion with automated or documented evidence, including build, lint, unit, i18n parity, portability, Playwright, and Lighthouse-style browser gates.

tasks.title: Perform critic review
tasks.acceptance: Review the implementation and QA evidence for blocking correctness, reliability, maintainability, accessibility, and requirement-traceability defects; resolve all real blocking findings.

tasks.title: Review security privacy and responsible AI
tasks.acceptance: Pass application security, privacy, and Responsible AI review including npm audit, secret scanning, dependency lockfile integrity, local-data handling, and runtime-network checks; resolve all real blocking findings.

gateResults.securityNote: Passed with human waiver; production audit gate is npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high (0 vulnerabilities). Re-run full npm audit when source-map-js 1.2.2 ships.

tasks.title: Deploy the approved Pinch artifact to GitHub Pages
tasks.acceptance: Merge the approved artifact to main without squash, deploy it through the governed GitHub Pages workflow, verify the approved tree and production smoke checks, document rollback, and snapshot the completed run.
